essays.text:
憲法第 11 條規定：「人民有言論、講學、著作及出版之自由。」上開規定除「講學自由」，大法官曾於司法院釋字第 380 號解釋指出：
「講學自由之規定，係對學術自由之制度性保障」外，憲法第 11 條所保障之權利一般通稱為「表現自由」。請依司法實務見解、主要學說分析：商業廣告是否受憲法上「表現自由」之保障？藥事法第 66 條第 1 項規定：
「藥商刊播藥物廣告時，應於刊播前將所有文字、圖畫或言詞，申請中央或直轄市衛生主管機關核准，並向傳播業者送驗核准文件。」之規定，是否違反禁止「事前審查原則」？（30 分）

英譯中：（20 分）“Land art,” an art using the environment to make an artistic point, isconsistently debated for its ethics. Many of its artworks are about therelationship between humans and the natural environment, including the harmwe often do to our planet. While many deem this form of art as a necessaryevil, others believe that the harm to the environment caused by land art cannotbe justified by the intention to spread awareness to a cause, however laudable.Some infamous instances include surrounding islands with floating fabric, andwrapping trees in plastic. These works have not only sparked ethical debatesbut ecological and legal ones as well.

中譯英：（20 分）近年來，以真實犯罪為題材的媒體，無論是播客還是影片形式，其人氣飆升的現象已經不再是什麼秘密。這個題材廣為流行，不僅僅是因為其娛樂性，還因為這一類型的作品可能解決懸案、讓久被忽視的案件重新曝光、並教育觀眾如何避免和預防自己身陷悲慘的情境。此外，許多人被真實犯罪媒體吸引，是因為它揭示了大多數人一生當中都不會經歷的黑暗人性。然而，犯罪現場的細節該披露到什麼程度，以及在創作真實犯罪內容時是否獲得了倖存者和家屬的同意，這些都引發了倫理上的顧慮。

英文作文：請根據下面的說明寫一篇約 300 字的英文作文（30 分）The concept of “social death” refers to a condition where an individual ismarginalized, isolated, or excluded from society, often leading to a loss ofidentity, dignity, and community connections. How does social death manifestin modern society, and what are its implications for individuals andcommunities? Write an essay about 300 words to discuss (1) the causes andconsequences of social death, and (2) explore potential solutions to addressthis issue. It is suggested that the writing include examples of social deathincidents drawn from real-life cases, news reports, or personal experiences.
